statement: ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, B < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定平移的 Θ 提升 · TP-0054 · 在任意界外找到差恰为二的两个素数
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta lift for a prescribed shift · TP-0054 · Find two primes exactly two apart beyond every bound

brief.zh: 输入可走窄窗归约或短长除数归约。每个界 B 必须有相应的新见证。
brief.en: Use either the window or the divisor reduction. Each lower bound B needs its own witness.
